shortDescription: Framework for randomly generated "titan" creatures: XML-defined traits with hidden-until-seen discovery, material (stuffed) creatures like steel wolves, inheritance through breeding. Works on any pawn.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and, later, a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance and (phase 2) materials.

## Status
- **Phase 1 (built, not yet tested in game):** traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- **Phase 2 (next):** material creatures.
- **Phase 3:** AI use of abilities by non-humanlikes, diet-changing traits, humanlike (Biotech) birth inheritance, hiding hidden traits from stat explanations.

## Why not genes
Animals have no gene tracker (genes are only created for Humanlike in PawnComponentsUtility). Most genes assume humanlike systems, gene mods would put humanlike-only genes on animals, and it would require Biotech.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- **Generation:** `commonality` (weight; 0 = never rolled), `pointCost` (negative = drawback, gives points back), `exclusionTags`, `tags` (for content-mod filtering), race filters (`allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other`, `requiresFlesh`, `min/maxBodySize`, `allowedRaces`, `disallowedRaces`).
- **Discovery:** `visible` (starts identified and in the name, e.g. Flaming), `discoverWhen` list of triggers: Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies. A trigger only counts if the player can see the creature (spawned and not fogged, or its corpse visible). `discoveryMessage` toggles the "X has revealed a hidden trait" message.
- **Naming:** `namePrefix`, `nameSuffix`, `nameOrder`. Only discovered traits affect the name.
- **Inheritance:** `heritable`, `inheritChance` (per carrying parent; compounds when both parents carry it).
- **Effects:** `stage` (a normal HediffStage), `hediffs` (extra hediffs, optional body part and severity; added and removed with the trait), `abilities` (granted; the framework creates an ability tracker on animals when needed), `traitClass` (a TitanTrait subclass for behaviour and per-creature saved state).
- ConfigErrors warn when a hidden trait's extra hediff would show in the health tab (it needs a stage with `becomeVisible=false`; discovery calls SetVisible on it), or when a trait can never be revealed.

## TitanTrait (instance, saved per creature)
Hooks: PostAdded, PreRemoved, PostDiscovered, TickInterval (only called when the class overrides it), Notify_PawnPostApplyDamage, Notify_PawnUsedVerb, Notify_PawnDied, TipStringExtra, ExposeData. Discover(notify) reveals it. Don't add or remove traits from the verb/damage/discovery hooks (vanilla is iterating hediffs at that point).

## Hediff_Titan (TF_Titan, one per titan)
- Holds the trait list. Merges every trait's stage into one cached stage: factors multiply, offsets add, flags OR, lists union. Stat offsets and factors merge per stat. Not merged: MTBs, thought/mood fields, severity-scaled lists, part-only fields, labels.
- Rebuilt only when traits change. Refreshes needs and disabled work when they change.
- Health tab: "titan traits (2 known, 1 unknown)". The tooltip lists each trait; unknown ones show as "???", and only discovered traits list their effects.
- Registered in a ConditionalWeakTable (TitanUtility) so the label patch never walks hediffs for ordinary pawns.

## TitanUtility (public API)
GetTitan, IsTitan, GetOrMakeTitan, CanAddTrait, AddTrait(pawn, def, discovered, force), RemoveTrait, ClearTitan, DiscoverAll, RollTraits(pawn, budget, maxTraits, validator), InheritTraits(child, mother, father), PlayerCanObserve.
RollTraits keeps picking weighted traits while points remain and something fits. Existing traits block conflicts but don't use budget.

## Harmony patches
- GenLabel.BestKindLabel(Pawn,…) postfix: adds discovered prefixes and suffixes to the kind label.
- Hediff_Pregnant.DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer: record the parents (same-gender otherParent ignored, as vanilla does).
- PawnUtility.TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix: InheritTraits before the newborn spawns. A trait starts discovered if it was discovered on either parent.

## Known limitations
- Vanilla stat explanations (info card breakdown) list the merged stage under "titan traits", so a hidden trait's numbers are visible there. A later patch could hide them.
- Abilities from hidden traits may show as gizmos on player-controlled pawns.
- Animals don't use abilities on their own yet (needs a think tree node).
- Humanlike births under Biotech don't inherit yet.

## Debug actions (category "Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits… (budget 1/3/5/10), Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples): remove or move before publishing
Flaming (visible, fire resistance), Venomous (hidden toxic-bite attack via hediff, discovered on use or death), Ironhide (hidden armor, discovered on damage), Of the Deep (hidden regeneration, suffix), Brittle (drawback, -1 cost).

## Phase 2 plan: materials (literal construct)
Material = a StuffDef on the titan hediff, always visible and always in the name ("jade bear"). Armor comes from the stuff's armor values, attack damage from its sharp/blunt multipliers, the body is tinted with the stuff's color, butchering yields the stuff, and market value scales. Construct properties: no bleeding, no pain, no breathing/toxic effects, no rot. Still eats, heals naturally and breeds. Traits may change diet (needs a FoodUtility.WillEat patch). Material is inherited from a parent.
